profileText: A Representative from New York; born in Ulster County, N.Y., December 5, 1762; attended the public schools; served in the Revolutionary War, New York militia; appointed deputy sheriff of Ulster County, N.Y., 1793; member of the New York state assembly, 1798-1800; sheriff of Orange County, N.Y., 1803-1805; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Ninth and Tenth Congresses (March 4, 1805-March 3, 1809); again a member of the New York state assembly, 1812,1813, and 1819; judge of the court of common pleas for Orange County, N.Y., 1815-1818; supervisor of the town of Montgomery fifteen terms; died on January 13, 1826, in Montgomery, Orange County, N.Y.; interment in the Berea Churchyard, near Newburgh, N.Y.
